damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from nonmagical attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Leviathan can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Siege Monster
additionalAbilities.description: The Leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures.

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
additionalAbilities.description: If the Leviathan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

additionalAbilities.name: Hyper-Pressurized Abyssal Aura
additionalAbilities.description: At the start of each of the Leviathan's turns, each creature within 30 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) cold damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature that touches the Leviathan or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes this damage as well. Additionally, the area within 30 feet of the Leviathan is difficult terrain for creatures other than darklings.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Leviathan can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its Bite and two with its Tentacle Slams.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18) and restrained.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute.

legendaryActions.name: Detect
legendaryActions.description: The Leviathan makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendaryActions.name: Tentacle Attack
legendaryActions.description: The Leviathan makes one Tentacle Slam attack.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Depths (Costs 2 Actions)
legendaryActions.description: The Leviathan intensifies its aura. Each creature within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet directly toward the Leviathan and knocked prone.

flavor.description: This invasive darkling prefers not to fight in its natural state. Instead, it seeps into dead or dying fungal architecture and puppeteers the hollow stalks like shambling mech-suits, turning abandoned garden-columns and rotting mycos halls into sudden ambush predators.

additionalAbilities.name: False Architecture
additionalAbilities.description: While inside dead or dormant fungal growth, the Symbiote is indistinguishable from ordinary Niolantean mycos-architecture.

additionalAbilities.name: Puppet Husk
additionalAbilities.description: While the Symbiote has not taken fire damage since the end of its last turn, it gains a +2 bonus to AC from its fungal host.

actions.name: Splinter Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Spore Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Symbiote releases a burst of soporific rot-spores in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of their next turn. A creature that fails this save while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 12 Potty Check; on a failure, lethargy and fungal discomfort cause it to lose 1 Use Charge.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance (Snowdrift)
additionalAbilities.description: While the Slush-Slurper remains motionless and buried within snow, it is indistinguishable from a mundane, powdery snowdrift. It perfectly mimics the ambient temperature, rendering it invisible to standard thermal scrying.

actions.name: Freezing Slurp (Grapple Attack)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13) as the darkling expands its viscous, freezing mass around the victim's waist and legs.

actions.name: Necrotic Frost Pump
actions.description: Bonus Action: Against a creature it is grappling, the Slush-Slurper pumps freezing necrotic sludge directly into the victim's garments. The target takes 7 (2d6) cold damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and their survival diaper immediately enters the debilitating, rigid Frozen state, reducing their speed by 10 feet and imposing disadvantage on Stealth checks even if they escape the grapple.

damageResistances: Piercing and Slashing from non-magical weapons

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the Scree-Roller is curled into a ball and remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a jagged pile of mountain rocks.

additionalAbilities.name: Momentum Trample
additionalAbilities.description: While taking the Dash action to roll, the Scree-Roller can move through the space of any Medium or smaller creature. When it does, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Curling Defense
reactions.description: When a creature the Scree-Roller can see targets it with a melee attack, it can use its reaction to curl into a tight, armored sphere, adding +3 to its AC against the attack.

additionalAbilities.name: Crackling Flight
additionalAbilities.description: Unlike its lesser cousins, the Hoarfrost-Yowler does not suffer the Clumsy Flier penalty. However, its stiff, frozen wings emit a loud, crackling sound, granting disadvantage on its Dexterity (Stealth) checks while flying.

actions.name: Frost-Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Freezing Screech (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Yowler emits a piercing, hyper-chilled screech infused with draconic sonic fury. Each creature within a 30-foot cone must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 10 (3d6) thunder damage and 10 (3d6) cold damage, and the ambient moisture around them flash-freezes, instantly plunging the temperature of any survival padding they wear to absolute zero and inflicting the Frozen state. On a success, the creature takes half damage and avoids the Frozen state.

additionalAbilities.name: Ice Walk & Spider Climb
additionalAbilities.description: The Spinner can move across icy surfaces and climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

additionalAbilities.name: Weaver's Echo
additionalAbilities.description: The Spinner ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing or ice, and it knows the exact location of any creature in contact with a web or frozen surface it is touching.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Spinner makes two attacks: one with its Frost-Bite and one with its Shadow-Limb.

actions.name: Frost-Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Shadow-Limb
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Absolute-Zero Web (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is restrained by an invisible, freezing silken web. While restrained in this way, the target takes 7 (2d6) cold damage at the start of each of its turns as the web drains its thermal energy. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 15 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; hp 15; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, cold, and poison damage).

flavor.description: These fragile, quivering balls of dark mist hide within the silent, snow-packed evergreen forests of the Hinterlands. They do not attack with physical force, but instead emit a highly localized, supernatural draft of sub-zero wind that actively dampens fire, saps energy, and bypasses the warming enchantments of travelers.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Sleepless
additionalAbilities.description: The Shiver does not need to sleep, and magic cannot put it to sleep.

additionalAbilities.name: Sipping warmth
additionalAbilities.description: Any spell or magical effect within 15 ft. of the Shiver that provides heat, fire resistance, or is a Padding Perfection spell has a 50% chance to fail instantly at the start of each of the Shiver's turns as the creature vacuums the ambient thermal energy.

actions.name: Frostbite Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) cold damage, and the target's movement speed is reduced by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Trembling Aura (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Shiver pulses with a wave of absolute sub-zero drafts in a 15-foot radius. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 7 (2d6) cold damage and is seized by violent, uncontrollable shivering, forcing a DC 11 Potty Check; on a failure, the intense full-body spasms cause the target to lose 1 Use Charge of their garment.

flavor.description: This hulking salvage-failure is a corroded warforged chassis awakened by ambient darkness and half-remembered guard orders. Its body leaks steam and black water from split seams as it lurches through dead maintenance sectors, smashing first and interpreting later.

additionalAbilities.name: Waterlogged Chassis
additionalAbilities.description: If the Slag-Brute takes lightning damage, it cannot take reactions and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Ancient Guard Protocol
additionalAbilities.description: The Slag-Brute has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that interacted with a door, lever, lock, or machine during the current round.

actions.name: Rust-Crusher Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bilge Ram
actions.description: The Slag-Brute moves up to 15 ft. in a straight line and makes one Rust-Crusher Fist attack. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. A creature knocked prone while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 12 Potty Check; on a failure, the impact and panic cause it to lose 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: This massive, subterranean threat slumbers deep beneath the impenetrable ice of the Rime-Glass Lake. It bursts upward through the ice sheets without warning to swallow foragers and scouts whole, exhaling a dense cloud of absolute-zero fog that freezes magical gear solid and locks targets in place.

stats.speed: 20 ft., burrow 40 ft. (through ice and snow only)

additionalAbilities.name: Ice Burrower
additionalAbilities.description: The Glacier-Maw can burrow through solid ice and snow without reducing its speed. It leaves no tunnel behind it.

additionalAbilities.name: Glacial Aura
additionalAbilities.description: The ground within a 20-foot radius of the Glacier-Maw is covered in thick, slippery frost and is treated as difficult terrain. Any creature that starts its turn in this area must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Swallow Forager
actions.description: The Glacier-Maw makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. On a hit, the target is swallowed. While swallowed, the creature takes 14 (4d6) cold damage and 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. Additionally, the cryonic pressure forces a DC 15 Potty Check; on a failure, the target suffers a critical failure (instantly losing all use charges and disabling all magical diaper buffs).

actions.name: Absolute Zero Belch (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Glacier-Maw expels a 30-foot cone of icy mist. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) cold damage and is paralyzed by ice. Additionally, any garments worn are frozen solid (AC reduced by 1, and speed is halved until thawed).

flavor.description: These floating, huffing balls of pure electrical static and shadow cluster around lonely wizard towers. They love short-circuiting defensive wards and delivering annoying static shocks to passing apprentices.

additionalAbilities.name: Static Disruption
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that hits the Squallkin with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 3 (1d6) lightning damage. Additionally, if the attacker is wearing a diaper or garment, the shocking jolt triggers an involuntary pelvic reflex, forcing the creature to make a DC 10 Potty Check; on a failure, they suffer a minor wetting accident, losing 1 Use Charge.

additionalAbilities.name: Sleepless
additionalAbilities.description: The Squallkin does not need to sleep, and magic cannot put it to sleep.

actions.name: Static Zap
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) lightning damage, and the target cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Disrupt Ward (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The Squallkin unleashes an EMP-like crackle targeting one spell effect of 1st level or lower within 15 ft. The Squallkin makes an Intelligence check (+0) against a DC of 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the spell effect ends immediately.

flavor.description: Born where darkling slime mixes with petrodistillate, alchemical runoff, and machine-filth, the Petro-Legion is less a creature than a living industrial spill. It oozes through forgotten bilges and gear gutters, suffocating scavengers, igniting catastrophically when struck by flame, and clogging vital city systems with sentient malice.

additionalAbilities.name: Amorphous
additionalAbilities.description: The Petro-Legion can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Volatile Fuel-Body
additionalAbilities.description: Whenever the Petro-Legion takes fire damage, each creature within 5 ft. of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Corrosive Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.

actions.name: Gear-Clog Engulf (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Legion moves up to its speed. It can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces during this move. A creature whose space it enters must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) acid damage and become restrained by the ooze until the end of the Legion's next turn. A restrained creature wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 13 Potty Check; on a failure, thick corrosive sludge ruins seals and tapes, causing the creature to lose 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: These noble failures are shadow-oozes poured into the ornate suits of dead Heraldian aristocrats. They posture like duelists, bow like courtiers, and slash with jerky, imitative elegance, all while clinging to a rotten memory of status and pageantry.

damageResistances: Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Hollow Nobility
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that misses the Gilded-Husk with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 2 (1d4) psychic damage from its unsettling mockery and impossible posture.

additionalAbilities.name: Duellist's Poise
additionalAbilities.description: The Gilded-Husk adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it each round.

actions.name: Gilded Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Aristocrat's Rebuke (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature within 20 ft. that can hear the Husk must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 12 Potty Check; on a failure, the humiliating magical reprimand causes it to lose 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: A colossal ambush bloom hiding among Niolantea's dense fungal terraces, the Umbralraune lures prey closer with hypnotic whispers and luminous foliage before constricting them in shadow-slick vines and dragging them into its maw-like flower.

stats.speed: 20 ft., burrow 20 ft. (through loose soil/fungal matter)
damageResistances: Bludgeoning and Piercing from Nonmagical Attacks
languages: Understands Common and Sylvan but speaks only in hypnotic, echoing whispers

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow-Root Ambush
additionalAbilities.description: While the Umbralraune remains motionless in dim light, darkness, or areas of dense Niolantean flora, she has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and appears as a massive, albeit exotic, blooming shadow-Rafflesia.

additionalAbilities.name: Toxic Allure
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Umbralraune and can see her glowing teal eyes and purple foliage must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become Charmed until the end of their next turn. A charmed creature is forced to use all its movement to approach her safely. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to her Toxic Allure for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Umbralraune makes two melee attacks. She can use any combination of her Constricting Vine-Lashes or her Toxospank.

actions.name: Constricting Vine-Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the Umbralraune cannot use this specific vine-lash on another target. She can grapple up to two creatures at once.

actions.name: Toxospank
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: The target takes 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and is struck by stinging, toxic shadow-sap. The target's movement speed drops to 10 ft. until the end of their next turn, and they take an additional 1d4 poison damage at the start of their turn for the next 1d4 rounds. Furthermore, if the Umbralraune successfully hits with this attack, she may choose to immediately expend her second action for the turn (if available) to pull the target into the center of her colossal flower and grapple them (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Sludge Kiss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Umbralraune pulls a grappled creature into her pitch-black, amorphous visage. The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, and the Umbralraune regains hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. Additionally, the terrifying, invasive nature of the darkling sludge forces the target to immediately make a Continence Check (as per the Combat Academy Regulation Handbook), potentially resulting in an immediate, humiliating accident. On a successful save, the target takes half the necrotic damage, is not forced to make a Continence Check, and the Umbralraune does not heal.

flavor.description: Suspended from the thick mangrove canopy, this chiropteran darkling resembles a slumbering fruit bat during the daylight hours. It possesses a violent aversion to solar energy, and if disturbed, it vents a static-laced, agonizing screech that disrupts magical focus throughout the delta.

additionalAbilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
additionalAbilities.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Perception checks while in direct sunlight.

additionalAbilities.name: Twilight Veil
additionalAbilities.description: While in dim light or darkness, the Sol-Shunner can use its bonus action to Hide.

actions.name: Venomous Shadow-Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Startle-Screech (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Sol-Shunner emits a high-pitched, echoing blast of sound. Each creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened. This traumatic shock forces an immediate DC 11 Potty Check; on a failure, the sudden terror causes a minor wetting accident, losing 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: This mud-caked delta hunter mimics the silhouette of a gaunt marsh-coyote, masking its shadowy hide beneath clay, reeds, and wet silt. Silt-Hounds circle prey through knee-deep channels and soft riverbanks, driving travelers into boggy traps before the pack descends.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The Silt-Hound has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: Mud-Caked Hide
additionalAbilities.description: While the Silt-Hound is in muddy terrain or shallow water, attack rolls against it made from more than 10 ft. away have disadvantage.

actions.name: Silt-Fang Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Reed-Herding Bark (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Silt-Hound unleashes a sharp, panicked yelp that coordinates nearby packmates. Each enemy within 15 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or move up to 10 ft. in a direction of the hound's choice if able. A creature that fails this save while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 12 Potty Check; on a failure, the forced stumble and fear cause it to lose 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: An opportunistic shoreline scavenger that stuffs its shadowy body into clam shells, driftwood hollows, and discarded crates to survive Dawnshore's punishing light. At dusk it pours out in a skittering blur, snatching trinkets, rations, and any loose supplies left by fishers or Delta Rangers.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While motionless inside a shell, crate, or driftwood hollow, the Shell-Skitterer is indistinguishable from mundane beach debris.

additionalAbilities.name: Scavenger Scuttle
additionalAbilities.description: If the Shell-Skitterer starts its turn holding a stolen object, it can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Skitter-Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Pilfering Snatch
actions.description: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or drop one held object of the Skitterer's choice. If the target is wearing a diaper or garment with exposed tapes, straps, or seals, it must also make a DC 11 Potty Check; on a failure, the creature loses 1 Use Charge as the Skitterer yanks something loose in the panic.

flavor.description: A wriggling, squid-like blob of translucent shadow-ooze that infests the flooded margins of the suburban coves. It loves nothing more than dragging its slippery, glistening body across pristine tile floors to surprise unwary travelers. Unlike common freshwater bracklings, this oceanic variant is highly adapted to the churning tidal salt-spray of the nameless coast.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Sea-Brackling can breathe both air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Ink Jet Dash
additionalAbilities.description: While submerged or airborne, the Sea-Brackling can expel a pressurized jet of ink as a bonus action, allowing it to take the Dash action without provoking opportunity attacks.

actions.name: Slippery Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Obscuring Ink Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Sea-Brackling ejects a 15-foot cone of dark, brackish ink. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature is blinded until the end of its next turn. Additionally, any affected creature wearing a diaper or garment must immediately make a DC 12 Potty Check; on a failure, the garment loses 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: A viscous, sludge-like darkling whose shadowy body has been permanently flash-frozen into sharp, scraping shards of black icicles. They crawl across the slick surface of the Rime-Glass Lake with a horrifying, metallic fingernail-on-chalkboard scraping sound, seeking warm travelers to latch onto.

additionalAbilities.name: Ice Walk
additionalAbilities.description: The Rimecreep can move across icy and snowy surfaces without needing to make ability checks. Difficult terrain composed of ice or snow does not cost it extra movement.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the Rimecreep remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cluster of natural dark icicles.

actions.name: Scraping Icicle Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 10).

actions.name: Freezing Contact
actions.description: The Rimecreep clamps its frozen mass onto a creature it is grappling, rapidly draining heat. At the start of each of the grappled target's turns, they take 4 (1d8) cold damage. Additionally, the biting chill flash-freezes the target's lower garments, forcing a DC 10 Potty Check; on a failure, the garment immediately enters the Frozen state (reducing speed by 10 ft. and imposing disadvantage on Stealth due to noisy, icy crinkling).

flavor.description: Fashioned by a decadent Heraldian duchess as a supposedly perfect silent servant, the Porcelain Thrall now wanders abandoned mid-spans in feral loops of housekeeping obsession. It glides toward intruders with spotless malice, trying to scrub, polish, and dissolve them into compliance.

additionalAbilities.name: False Servant
additionalAbilities.description: While standing still with hands folded or posed as a decorative attendant, the Thrall is indistinguishable from an ornate porcelain statue.

additionalAbilities.name: Shatter Skitter
additionalAbilities.description: When the Thrall takes bludgeoning damage but isn't destroyed, it can move up to 10 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks as cracks ripple across its body.

actions.name: Acid Polish Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) acid damage.

actions.name: Scouring Splash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Thrall sprays a fan of alchemical cleanser in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) acid damage and have disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll they make before the end of their next turn. A creature that fails this save while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 12 Potty Check; on a failure, cleaning fluid ruins tapes and padding, causing it to lose 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: This entity is physically unstable, stuttering through the flora with disjointed motions and shadowy afterimages caused by local temporal anomalies. Because it exists in a micro-loop of its own past and future, it is notoriously difficult to strike, often "rewinding" itself away from incoming attacks.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Temporal Stutter
additionalAbilities.description: Attacks against the Stalker have disadvantage unless it is incapacitated or has its speed reduced to 0.

additionalAbilities.name: Chronomantic Avoidance (Reaction)
additionalAbilities.description: When hit by a melee attack, the Stalker can teleport 10 ft. to a visible space, halving the damage as it rewinds one second into the past.

actions.name: Disjointed Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Stutter-Resonance Pulse (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Stalker emits a 10-ft radius wave of temporal echoes. Creatures must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) force damage. The glitch forces an involuntary regression; on a failure, a DC 12 Potty Check causes them to comically lose 1 Use Charge as their muscles relax.

flavor.description: Grease-Mites are skittering little maintenance parasites that feed on machine lubricants, alchemical sealants, and magical padding adhesives. They are more nuisance than brute threat, but a cluster of them can unravel a mechanic's preparation in seconds.

additionalAbilities.name: Crack-Crawler
additionalAbilities.description: The Grease-Mite can move through a space as narrow as half an inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Seal-Feeder
additionalAbilities.description: The Grease-Mite has advantage on ability checks made to open, loosen, peel, or disable fastenings, bindings, or machine seals.

actions.name: Grease Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Unfasten
actions.description: One creature within 5 ft. wearing a diaper, garment, harness, or strapped equipment must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or lose 1 Use Charge as the Grease-Mite magically peels, unsnaps, or untapes a fastening. If the target is concentrating on a spell or operating a machine, it must also succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or lose concentration / mishandle the device.

flavor.description: A silky, sludge-like shadow that prefers being donned over skulking in the muck. Eccentric hunters and thrill-seeking fae throughout the meadows seek these entities to drape across their shoulders like shifting starlit obsidian. While it siphons ambient mana to grant the wearer short-range teleports, it will greedily constrict and attempt a full possession if the host grows weak.

additionalAbilities.name: Symbiotic Shadow
additionalAbilities.description: While worn as a garment, the mantle cannot be targeted; attacks hit the host instead. The wearer can use a bonus action to teleport 20 ft. to a visible space, but doing so siphons kinetic energy, costing 1 Use Charge of their garment.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While motionless, the mantle is indistinguishable from a velvet neck-wrap or shawl.

actions.name: Slippery Envelop
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) acid damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 11). If the target is wearing a diaper, the squeezing pressure forces a DC 11 Potty Check; on a failure, they suffer a minor wetting accident, losing 1 Use Charge.

actions.name: Parasitic Possession
actions.description: The mantle tries to seize control of a grappled creature. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or be blinded as the mantle wraps around their head. The mantle gains control of their movement on its next turn until the effect ends.

flavor.description: These knife-winged scavengers ride the violent thermals above the Westersea, clustering in ragged dive-bombing packs. They are terrifying against exposed sailors and skiff crews, but their unstable storm-body burns out spectacularly when caught in Stormveil's disciplined lightning defenses.

additionalAbilities.name: Flyby
additionalAbilities.description: The Harrier doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

additionalAbilities.name: Stormveil Instability
additionalAbilities.description: Whenever the Harrier takes lightning damage, its flying speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Razor Dive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Snatch Loose Gear
actions.description: One creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or drop one small held object. If the creature is wearing a diaper or garment with exposed straps, it must also make a DC 11 Potty Check; on a failure, the Harrier's pass tears away a fastening and the creature loses 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: This flattened, skittering shadow-beast lurks within the silt-laden edges of the coastal delta. By tucking its spindly, oily legs beneath its glossy carapace, it assumes the perfect likeness of a smooth river stone or a discarded crab shell. Travelers who tread too close find themselves ensnared by vice-like pincers that specifically hunger for legs and protective padding.

additionalAbilities.name: Sunlight Fear
additionalAbilities.description: The mimic suffers disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while exposed to unshaded, direct sunlight.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While remaining still, the mimic is visually indistinguishable from a large delta stone or aquatic shell.

actions.name: Pincer Pinch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11).

actions.name: Delta Mud Squeeze
actions.description: The mimic applies a punishing, localized clamp to a grappled creature's lower limbs. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Potty Check; on a failure, the crushing pressure forces a wetting accident, losing 1 Use Charge of their garment.

flavor.description: This drifting storm-body is a conscious imitation of the World-Seam's worst sky violence: a swollen mass of darkling vapor, necrotic hail, and murderous downdrafts. It crushes aerial travelers and small vessels beneath its private weather, but recoils instinctively from coordinated lightning retaliation.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Storm Mass
additionalAbilities.description: The Thunderhead can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Downdraft Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Flying creatures that start their turns within 15 ft. of the Thunderhead must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or descend up to 20 ft. immediately.

additionalAbilities.name: Conductive Collapse
additionalAbilities.description: When the Thunderhead takes lightning damage, it loses its Downdraft Aura until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Necrotic Hail
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) cold damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: World-Seam Imitation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Thunderhead erupts in a 30-foot-radius burst of hail, thunder, and crushing wind centered on itself. Creatures in the area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (4d10) cold and thunder damage, is pushed up to 15 ft. in a direction of the Thunderhead's choice, and is knocked prone if it lands on a surface. A creature that fails this save while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 15 Potty Check; on a failure, the concussive panic and violent pressure cause it to lose 2 Use Charges.

flavor.description: This iron-vine impostor hangs among Niolantea's hanging gardens and living bridges, glowing with a false, welcoming bioluminescence. When a druid, courier, or wildshaper draws close, the Strangleweed unwraps itself from the architecture and constricts with botanical malice.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning and Piercing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: False Bioluminescence
additionalAbilities.description: While motionless among vines, roots, or cables, the Strangleweed is indistinguishable from decorative Niolantean iron-vines.

additionalAbilities.name: Lurking Reach
additionalAbilities.description: Opportunity attacks made by the Strangleweed have a reach of 15 ft.

actions.name: Iron-Vine Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Canopy Reel (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: One creature grappled by the Strangleweed is pulled up to 20 ft. in a direction of the creature's choice and takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage if it collides with a solid surface. A creature moved this way while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 13 Potty Check; on a failure, the crushing constriction and violent jerk cause it to lose 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: High in the angular branches of the Astrum Canopy, this avian horror hides as a silhouette among the star-shaped limbs. When prey strays beneath, the Shrike drops like a thrown knife, its metallic shadow-glass plumage turning a silent dive into a lethal impalement.

damageResistances: Piercing and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Canopy Ambusher
additionalAbilities.description: The Star-Shrike has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't acted yet in combat while it is in dim light, darkness, or heavy foliage.

additionalAbilities.name: Dive Impaler
additionalAbilities.description: If the Shrike moves at least 20 ft. downward straight toward a target and hits with Talons on the same turn, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Star-Shrike makes two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Shadow-Glass Feather Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Shrike explodes a volley of razor feathers in a 20-foot cone. Creatures in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 13 Potty Check; on a failure, the shock and pain cause it to lose 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: This beautifully eerie avian resembles a coastal darter drying its wings upon a half-sunken delta log. Yet its plumage is composed of absolute pitch-shadow that actively consumes ambient light, casting a localized eclipse around its form.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Solar Eclipse Wings
additionalAbilities.description: The area within 10 ft. of the Sol-Anhinga is perpetually shrouded in dim light as it drinks in the sun.

additionalAbilities.name: Water Dart
additionalAbilities.description: The bird gains advantage on melee attacks against targets currently submerged in water.

actions.name: Spearing Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Eclipse Feather Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The bird launches a freezing barrage of shadow-feathers in a 30-foot cone. Creatures must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity save or take 14 (4d6) cold damage. The biting chill forces a DC 13 Potty Check; on a failure, the garment immediately enters the Frozen state, reducing speed by 10 ft. and imposing noisy, icy crinkling.

flavor.description: A grotesque, skeletal parody of a massive elk or moose, completely encrusted in black permafrost and shifting shadow-vapor. It stalks the frozen tundra, charging with terrifying momentum and impaling travelers upon its massive, fractal antlers of solid shadow-ice.

additionalAbilities.name: Trample Charge
additionalAbilities.description: If the Shatterhorn moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

additionalAbilities.name: Frost Aura
additionalAbilities.description: At the start of each of the Shatterhorn's turns, each creature within 5 ft. of it takes 3 (1d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one prone target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shatter-Roar (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The Shatterhorn lets out a bone-rattling, crystalline bellow. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) thunder damage, is deafened, and must immediately make a DC 13 Potty Check; on a failure, the vibrating force causes a major failure, instantly losing 2 Use Charges and becoming stunned with embarrassment.

flavor.description: A hyper-fertile blossom corrupted by darkforme essence, this canopy predator appears as a breathtaking oversized flower until it exhales its infamous Pink Fog. The haze makes victims sluggish, confused, and humiliatingly vulnerable before the flower's hidden tendrils close in.

stats.speed: 30 ft. (Split between the three bodies), climb 20 ft.

additionalAbilities.name: Rooted Predator
additionalAbilities.description: While the Rot-Blossom hasn't moved since the start of its last turn, attack rolls against it from more than 20 ft. away have disadvantage as petals and spores distort its outline.

additionalAbilities.name: Canopy Bloom
additionalAbilities.description: The Rot-Blossom can occupy vertical surfaces and hanging fungal shelves as though they were the ground.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Rot-Blossom makes three attacks with its Rot-Tendrils. If available, it can choose to replace one of these Rot-Tendril attacks with its Pink Fog Exhalation.

actions.name: Rot-Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Pink Fog Exhalation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Blossom exhales a 30-foot cone of hallucinogenic, necrotic pollen. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and is plunged into a chemical, dreamlike state that drastically reduces and dulls all physical senses. While in this state, the creature is poisoned, has disadvantage on all Wisdom (Perception) checks, and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. Because this is a severe biological and neuro-chemical suppression rather than an enchantment, it is explicitly not magical sleep and bypasses all racial or magical immunities to sleep effects. Additionally, the extreme lethargy and total bodily surrender force the creature to immediately make a DC 15 Continence Check (Potty Check), regardless of whether they are wearing a diaper or standard garments. On a failure, they suffer a humiliating accident (losing 2 Use Charges if padded, or heavily soiling their clothing if unpadded). On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and suffers no additional effects.

flavor.description: A broad, manta-like hunter of flattened darkness, the Nimbus-Ray glides almost soundlessly on the wild thermals over the Westersea. Its favored tactic is to settle over a small vessel like a falling storm canopy, trapping crew in darkness while it feeds.

additionalAbilities.name: Blanketing Glide
additionalAbilities.description: The Nimbus-Ray can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures while flying without provoking opportunity attacks.

additionalAbilities.name: Dark Canopy
additionalAbilities.description: The area directly beneath the Nimbus-Ray out to 10 ft. is heavily obscured.

actions.name: Crushing Wing-Edge
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Smothering Drop (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Nimbus-Ray descends onto a point it can see within 30 ft. Each creature in a 15-foot radius beneath it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and become blinded until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 14 Potty Check; on a failure, panic in the sudden darkness causes it to lose 1 Use Charge.

flavor.description: Appearing as a massive, twisted knot of black moss and necrotic roots, this entity lies in wait within the delta muck. It uses its thick, tendril-like appendages to drag travelers into the high-pressure swampy sludge, feeding greedily on their physical and spiritual exhaustion.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning and Piercing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Spider Climb
additionalAbilities.description: The Matriarch traverses difficult surfaces and ceilings without needing ability checks.

additionalAbilities.name: Sunlight Allergy
additionalAbilities.description: Direct sunlight causes 5 radiant damage at the start of its turn and halves its movement speed.

actions.name: Grasping Shadow-Root
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. The target is restrained and grappled (escape DC 14).

actions.name: Swampy Siphon (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Matriarch channels decaying energy into a grappled victim. On a failed DC 14 Constitution save, the target takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and suffers a major messing accident. The high hydrostatic pressure forces them to lose 2 Use Charges instantly, leaving them incapacitated with shock.

flavor.description: A beautifully eerie evolution born when a darkling mimics the biology of a consumed fae. This creature resembles a butterfly with wings of geometric void-slices. Its flapping scatters sparkling "temporal dust" that randomly alters the age of everything it touches.

additionalAbilities.name: Magic Resistance
additionalAbilities.description: The Ghast has advantage on saves against magical effects and spells.

additionalAbilities.name: Void Edge
additionalAbilities.description: Melee attacks from its wings ignore half and three-quarters cover.

actions.name: Razor Void-Wing
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Temporal Dust Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Ghast scatters a 30-ft cone of glittering dust. Creatures take 14 (4d6) psychic damage on a failed DC 13 Wisdom save. The regression forces a DC 13 Potty Check; on a failure, the sudden return to toddlerhood causes them to wet their diaper, losing 1 Use Charge and gaining disadvantage on Wisdom saves.

flavor.description: A towering, amorphous mass of water-logged shadow-ooze that perfectly mimics the apocalyptic monsoons of the World-Seam. It stalks travelers through dry coves, attempting to envelop and drown them inside its own cold, necrotic body.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Amorphous
additionalAbilities.description: The Deluge can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Water-Logged Core
additionalAbilities.description: If the Deluge takes cold damage, its speed is reduced by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn as its outer layers temporarily freeze.

actions.name: Water-Logged Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Drowning Engulf (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Deluge moves up to its speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Any creature whose space the Deluge enters must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the creature is pushed 5 ft. to the side. On a failure, the creature takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and is engulfed. An engulfed creature cannot breathe, is restrained, and takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the Deluge's turns. Additionally, due to the freezing and heavy hydrostatic pressure of the swampy ooze surrounding them, an engulfed creature wearing a diaper or garment must make a DC 15 Potty Check at the start of each of its turns. On a failure, the sheer pressure forces a wetting accident, losing 1 Use Charge of their garment. An engulfed creature can escape by spending an action to succeed on a DC 15 Strength check. The Deluge can engulf up to two Medium creatures or one Large creature at a time.

flavor.description: A looming, spider-like entity that stalks the meadow boundaries. Instead of silk, it weaves stagnant temporal energy to trap victims in local loops. Prey is forced to repeat the exact microsecond of capture while the snare feeds on their psychic frustration.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Spider Climb
additionalAbilities.description: The Snare can traverse difficult surfaces and ceilings without making ability checks.

additionalAbilities.name: Temporal Sense
additionalAbilities.description: It automatically detects any creature within 60 ft. affected by time-altering spells or conditions like Haste or Slow.

actions.name: Piercing Shadow-Leg
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Weave Chrono-Snare (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Shoots a sphere of temporal stagnation at a point within 60 ft. Creatures must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity save or be restrained and forced to repeat their last action. Biological functions loop as well: a failed DC 14 Potty Check at the start of each turn causes a wetting accident, losing 1 Use Charge. Wisdom saves can break the loop.

flavor.description: The crowning blasphemy of a mad Heraldian king, the Chimeric Dread was engineered as a pet noble apex predator. It bears the silhouette of a griffin twisted by dark essence, with shifting feathers of shadow-glass, exposed bone, and a vicious certainty that anything not of royal blood exists beneath it.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Royal Blood Scent
additionalAbilities.description: The Chimeric Dread automatically knows whether a creature within 60 ft. has noble lineage, royal magic, or Heraldian court insignia.

additionalAbilities.name: Magic Resistance
additionalAbilities.description: The Chimeric Dread has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Chimeric Dread makes one Beak attack and two Talon attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talon
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Sovereign Shriek (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Dread unleashes a regal hunting cry in a 30-foot cone. Creatures in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 14 (4d6) psychic damage and become frightened until the end of their next turn. A creature that fails this save while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 15 Potty Check; on a failure, the crushing aristocratic terror causes it to lose 2 Use Charges.

flavor.description: The shadow-monarch of the deepest Astrum Canopy resembles an impossibly calm elk wrought from black roots, obsidian, and slow-breathing darkness. It does not rage or panic like lesser darkformes; it simply decides an intruder has crossed a boundary, and then annihilates them with unstoppable, ritualistic force.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning and Piercing from Nonmagical Attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Territorial Charge
additionalAbilities.description: If the Bramble-Stag moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with Gore on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

additionalAbilities.name: Root-Sure Footing
additionalAbilities.description: The Bramble-Stag ignores nonmagical difficult terrain made of roots, undergrowth, mud, or brambles.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Bramble-Stag makes one Gore attack and one Hoof attack.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Hoof
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Canopy Monarch's Bellow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Bramble-Stag releases a deep, resonant territorial bellow. Each hostile creature within 30 ft. that can hear it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of its next turn. A creature that fails this save while wearing a diaper or garment must also make a DC 14 Potty Check; on a failure, the overwhelming instinctive terror forces it to lose 2 Use Charges.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Eastersea Dossier: Geography, History, and Bestiary. They terrorize the trade lanes between Darvitch and the outer islands.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Amphibiousness
additionalAbilities.description: The Corsair-Orca can breathe both air and water. While in water, it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

additionalAbilities.name: Keen Hearing
additionalAbilities.description: The Corsair-Orca has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

additionalAbilities.name: Echolocation Suppression
additionalAbilities.description: While in pitch darkness or heavily obscured water, the Corsair-Orca can emit a magical sonar click. Up to three creatures of its choice within 60ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or have their passive perception reduced by -5 for 1minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Corsair-Orca makes two attacks: one with its Hardened Dark-Ice Cutlass and one with its Crushing Tail.

actions.name: Hardened Dark-Ice Cutlass
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Crushing Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Harpoon of the Deep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/90ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 16) and pulled up to 30ft. directly toward the Corsair-Orca.

flavor.environment: Derived from Dossier of the Glacial Domain: Throne of the Glimmergale. They run in packs across the causally frozen glaciers of the polar range.

additionalAbilities.name: Temporal Displacement
additionalAbilities.description: The Age-Hound is constantly flickering milliseconds out of the current timeline. Attack rolls against it have disadvantage unless the attacker has blindsight or truesight.

additionalAbilities.name: Keen Tracker
additionalAbilities.description: The Age-Hound has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track creatures that have taken damage in the last 24hours.

actions.name: Aging Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be afflicted by rapid cellular aging. The target's speed is halved, and they have disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws for 1minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

flavor.environment: Derived from Dossier of the Glacial Domain: Throne of the Glimmergale. They stalk the freezing, wind-whipped valleys bordering the Jagged Sea.

additionalAbilities.name: Sapping Aura
additionalAbilities.description: Any non-undead creature that starts its turn within 10ft. of the Wizenbear must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. The Wizenbear regains hit points equal to the total necrotic damage dealt by this aura.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Wizenbear makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Claws.

actions.name: Decaying Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Wizen Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, its Strength score is reduced by 1d4 as muscles wither under the claws' curse. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Dracoseam: Chronicles of the Eastern Planar Boundary. It patrols the temporal and gravity shears near the cascading World waterfall.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from non-magical attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Temporal Paradox
additionalAbilities.description: When the Echo Inquisitor hits a creature with an attack, the target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted by a temporal paradox. On a failed save, the target takes an extra 18 (3d6) psychic damage and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn as its movements are briefly out of sync with time.

additionalAbilities.name: Reality Glitch
additionalAbilities.description: When the Echo Inquisitor is hit by an attack, it can use its reaction to flicker out of reality, granting itself resistance to the triggering attack's damage and teleporting 15ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Echo Inquisitor makes three Temporal Lash attacks.

actions.name: Temporal Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) force damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Planar Shift (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: As a bonus action, the Echo Inquisitor can teleport up to 60ft.. After teleporting, it can choose one creature within 10ft. of its destination. That creature must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or be banished to a random void pocket for 1round, returning to its original space (or the nearest unoccupied space) at the start of its next turn, taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage from the cosmic vertigo.

actions.name: Singularity Collapse (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The Inquisitor targets a point it can see within 60ft., momentarily multiplying the gravity of the World Gash. Each creature in a 20ft. radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) force damage and being pulled 15ft. toward the center on a failed save, or half as much damage and not pulled on a successful one.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Eastersea Dossier: Geography, History, and Bestiary. She rules the absolute deepest abyssal trenches of the Eastersea.

damageImmunities: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from non-magical attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
additionalAbilities.description: If The Ebongoreel fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

additionalAbilities.name: Aura of the Polluted Sea
additionalAbilities.description: The water within 120ft. of The Ebongoreel is thick with metaphysical malice. It is considered difficult terrain for non-Darkformes. Any non-Darkforme creature that starts its turn in this water must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and be poisoned until the start of their next turn. If a student of the Academy fails this save, they must immediately roll a Continence Check due to the overwhelming, sickening somatic pressure.

additionalAbilities.name: Pants-Crapping Fear Presence
additionalAbilities.description: When first faced with the Ebongoreel, players must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution (Continence) check or immediately soil themselves in absolute primal terror, becoming incapacitated with fear until the end of their next turn. This effect can only occur once per encounter. A high-tech diaper (such as TactiTush or DiaperDynamo) soiled in this manner loses 3 structural charges.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Ebongoreel can use her Frightful Presence. She then makes three attacks: one with her Bite and two with her Shadow-Tentacles.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.description: Each creature of the Ebongoreel's choice within 120ft. of her and aware of her must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Shadow-Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 20ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Breath of the Ruined Sea (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Ebongoreel exhales a 90ft. cone of pure, concentrated darkforme animus and toxic sludge. Each creature in that area must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) necrotic damage and 33 (6d10) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Eastersea Dossier: Geography, History, and Bestiary. They inhabit the pristine open waters and coastal shallows of the Eastersea.

additionalAbilities.name: Zero-Friction Swimmer
additionalAbilities.description: The Slip-Stream Seal possesses innate magic that reduces water friction to absolute zero. It ignores difficult terrain caused by water currents, rapids, or aquatic spells, and opportunity attacks against it are made with disadvantage while it is swimming.

additionalAbilities.name: Friendly Boop
additionalAbilities.description: The seal intentionally seeks out friendly humanoids. Its playful nature grants it advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact favorably with other creatures.

actions.name: Playful Ram
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone by the seal's frictionless slide.

actions.name: Slip-Stream Splash (Recharge 4-5)
actions.description: The seal splashes water at a creature within 15ft.. The target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the target's feet or boots are coated in frictionless water, halving their movement speed and giving them disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws until the start of the seal's next turn.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Westerseam: Industrial Governance of the Worldsplit. They walk the abyssal ocean floor directly underneath the massive, neon-lit Seam-Rigs.

damageResistances: Piercing and Slashing from non-magical attacks
languages: Understands the languages it knew in life but cannot speak

additionalAbilities.name: Pressurized Miasma
additionalAbilities.description: The suit is over-pressurized with toxic black seawater. Whenever the Trench-Walker takes piercing or slashing damage, a jet of high-pressure toxic ooze sprays out of the breach. Any creature within 5ft. of the Trench-Walker must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9 (2d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

additionalAbilities.name: Heavy Tread
additionalAbilities.description: The Trench-Walker ignores difficult terrain caused by water, mud, or strong currents. It cannot float and always sinks to the bottom of any body of water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Trench-Walker makes two attacks with its Rusted Anchor.

actions.name: Rusted Anchor
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Harpoon Line (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/60ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled, the target is restrained, and the Trench-Walker can use a bonus action to reel the target up to 20ft. directly toward it.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Igneous Taxa of Gildermount: A Volcanic Bestiary. They dig elaborate tunnel networks through the volcanic dust flats of Gildermount.

additionalAbilities.name: Subterranean Ambush
additionalAbilities.description: The Ground-Owl has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it attacks directly after emerging from its burrow.

additionalAbilities.name: Eartheye Sonar
additionalAbilities.description: While burrowed, the Ground-Owl can perceive the location of any moving creature within 30ft. of it.

actions.name: Obsidian Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dust Burst (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Ground-Owl beats its stubby wings, kicking up a blinding cloud of sand and dirt in a 10ft. radius. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

flavor.environment: They spin their webs across the boiling hot springs and ash-choked ledges of the volcanic peaks of Gildermount.

additionalAbilities.name: Igneous Web Walker
additionalAbilities.description: The Ember-Spinner ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing of any kind.

additionalAbilities.name: Volatile Silk
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that touches the Ember-Spinner's web or starts its turn restrained by it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. The web is highly flammable; if exposed to open flame, the entire web ignites, dealing an immediate 10 (3d6) fire damage to anyone caught within it before burning away.

additionalAbilities.name: Thermal Shock
additionalAbilities.description: Whenever the Ember-Spinner takes Water damage, the glowing magma core within its abdomen violently cools and cracks. Its climbing speed is reduced to 0ft. until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Searing Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Ember Web (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60ft., one target. Hit: The target is restrained by fiery webbing. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 12 Strength check, bursting the web on a success. The web can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; vulnerability to water; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

flavor.environment: Derived from The Dracoseam: Chronicles of the Eastern Planar Boundary. She floats through the crumbling cosmic rubble of suspended islands at the edge of space.

additionalAbilities.name: Precognitive Sight
additionalAbilities.description: The Seeress cannot be surprised and adds her Wisdom modifier to her Armor Class (included in AC). Attack rolls against her cannot benefit from advantage.

actions.name: Spectral Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Hex of the Unraveling (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Seeress targets one creature she can see within 60ft.. The target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and is cursed with misfortune. For the next 1minute, the target must roll a 1d4 and subtract the result from every attack roll, saving throw, or ability check they make.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Eastersea Dossier: Geography, History, and Bestiary. They swarm along the coastlines of the outer islands and the eastern sandy barrier shores.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Tide-Crab can breathe air and water.

additionalAbilities.name: Coral Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Tide-Crab has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide among rocky shores, coral reefs, or sandy beaches.

actions.name: Double Pinch
actions.description: The Tide-Crab makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12). The Tide-Crab has two pincers, each of which can grapple one target.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Rift-Caste Darklings: Matriarchy of the Gash. They drop from the high rock towers and suspended bridges of the Rift territory.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from non-magical weapons

additionalAbilities.name: Gravitic Plunge
additionalAbilities.description: If the Marauder glides or falls at least 20ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a Shrapnel Blade attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 14 (4d6) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Marauder makes two Scrap-Metal attacks.

actions.name: Shrapnel Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Marauder spins her blades in a lethal circle. Each creature within 5ft. of her must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Rift-Caste Darklings: Matriarchy of the Gash. They command the defensive outposts and ritual temples of the Gash.

additionalAbilities.name: Gravity Warp
additionalAbilities.description: Ranged weapon attacks made against the Rift-Invoker have disadvantage as she passively bends the low-gravity space around her body.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Invoker makes two Force-Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Force-Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Spectral Soul-Gun (1/Turn)
actions.description: The Invoker levels her spiritual firearm and fires a highly compressed, screaming bullet of pure necrotic energy. Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 60ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Singularity Collapse (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Invoker targets a point she can see within 60ft., momentarily multiplying the gravity of the World Gash. Each creature in a 20ft. radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) force damage and being pulled 10ft. toward the center on a failed save, or half as much damage and not pulled on a successful one.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Rift-Caste Darklings: Matriarchy of the Gash. They inhabit the aeries and hanging platforms built along the sheer cliffs of the Gash.

additionalAbilities.name: Low-Gravity Glider
additionalAbilities.description: The Rift-Hunter does not suffer movement penalties in zero-gravity. If it falls, it can glide safely, taking no falling damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The Hunter has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5ft. of the creature and isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Hunter makes two attacks with its Scrap-Bayonet or two attacks with its Hand-Crossbow. Once per turn, it can replace one Scrap-Bayonet attack with a Scrap-Gun Blast.

actions.name: Scrap-Bayonet
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand-Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Scrap-Gun Blast (1/Turn)
actions.description: The Hunter fires the volatile, cobbled-together firearm integrated into its bayonet at point-blank range. Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 10ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Westerseam: Industrial Governance of the Worldsplit. They pool inside deep mine shafts, extraction shafts, and the drainage tunnels of the western operations.

additionalAbilities.name: Abyssal Tripwire
additionalAbilities.description: A creature moving through the Quickslime's space must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone. The Quickslime can then use its reaction to burrow or move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

additionalAbilities.name: Amorphous
additionalAbilities.description: The slime can move through a space as narrow as 1inch wide without squeezing.

flavor.environment: Derived from Dossier of the Glacial Domain: Throne of the Glimmergale. They forage along the sub-zero high slopes and frozen woodlands of the range.

additionalAbilities.name: Temporal Leap
additionalAbilities.description: When the Lagoform takes the Jump action, it can teleport up to 15ft. of the total jump distance, passing cleanly through solid structures and barriers.

additionalAbilities.name: Decoy Scent
additionalAbilities.description: When targeted by an attack, the Lagoform can use its reaction to swap places with a temporal shadow-clone. The attack rolls against the clone instead, destroying it instantly, and the real Lagoform teleports 10ft. away. This trait can be used twice per short rest.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

flavor.environment: They infest the foundries, burn pits, and molten slag heaps of Dimspark and the path of Franny's Flight.

additionalAbilities.name: Slag Trail
additionalAbilities.description: The Fire-Dracklie constantly drips melted material. Any creature that starts its turn within 5ft. of the Dracklie, or steps into a space it occupied on its last turn, takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Dense Physiology
additionalAbilities.description: Because they are the compressed mass of a Huge creature, they are incredibly dense. They have advantage on Strength saving throws against being pushed or knocked prone.

additionalAbilities.name: Incessant Yapping
additionalAbilities.description: While they are hard to eat and ignored by larger darklings, their high-pitched, echoing barks make stealth impossible for anyone within 60ft. of them.

actions.name: Playful Snap
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

flavor.environment: Derived from Dossier of the Glacial Domain: Throne of the Glimmergale. They root themselves disguised as dead, icy mountain shrubs along freezing high passes.

additionalAbilities.name: Thorn Body
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that hits the Bushelgreed with a melee attack while within 5ft. of it takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance
additionalAbilities.description: While the Bushelgreed remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a dead, dried-out desert or mountain bush.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Bushelgreed makes two attacks with its Thorny Vines.

actions.name: Thorny Vines
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 15ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Asset Snatch
actions.description: The Bushelgreed makes an Athletics check against a grappled target's Athletics or Acrobatics check. On a success, the Bushelgreed strips a random item of equipment, a backpack, or a belt-pouch from the victim, immediately storing it in its thorny hollow belly.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Westerseam: Industrial Governance of the Worldsplit. They target supply lockers, changing structures, and rest quarters within the industrial deep mines.

additionalAbilities.name: False Appearance (Padding)
additionalAbilities.description: While the Diaper Mimic remains motionless, it is entirely indistinguishable from a folded, high-quality magical survival diaper.

additionalAbilities.name: Adhesive Trap
additionalAbilities.description: When a creature attempts to wear or handle the mimic, it instantly reverts to its shadow-ooze form, automatically grappling the target (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the mimic cannot trap another target.

actions.name: Necrotic Siphon
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, automatically hits a creature grappled by the mimic. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) necrotic damage, and the mimic heals for half the damage dealt as it feeds on the victim's vital warmth.

flavor.environment: They roll down the steep basalt terrace slopes of the primary volcanic cones of Gildermount.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from non-magical weapons

additionalAbilities.name: Superheated Core
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that touches the Magma-Roller or hits it with a melee attack while within 5ft. of it takes 4 (1d8) fire damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Crushing Momentum
additionalAbilities.description: If the Magma-Roller moves at least 20ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a Slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.
