If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

additionalAbilities.name: Thermal Shock
additionalAbilities.description: Whenever the Magma-Roller takes Water damage, the molten darkling ooze acting as the mortar for its basalt plates instantly hardens into brittle stone. It loses its Crushing Momentum trait and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Dracoseam: Chronicles of the Eastern Planar Boundary. They anchor themselves to the hovering Cosmic Scarps near the cascading edge of the World-Seam.

additionalAbilities.name: Scarp Anchor
additionalAbilities.description: As a bonus action, the Hippocampus can wrap its prehensile tail around any solid object or terrain (such as a floating rock or coral column). While anchored, it cannot be moved, pushed, or pulled by any physical or magical force, including the gravity of the Great Spill.

actions.name: Bone-Snout Lance
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Current Vacuum (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Hippocampus opens its tubular snout and rapidly inhales the surrounding water or mist. Each creature within a 30ft. cone must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be pulled 20ft. directly toward the entity and take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage from the crushing pressure.

flavor.environment: They hunt within the active sulfur vents, scalding mud cauldrons, and caldera margins of Gildermount.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from non-magical weapons

additionalAbilities.name: Obsidian Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Caldera-Lurker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain, ash clouds, or mud pots.

additionalAbilities.name: Erupting Pounce
additionalAbilities.description: If the Caldera-Lurker moves at least 20ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the Caldera-Lurker can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

additionalAbilities.name: Thermal Shock
additionalAbilities.description: Whenever the Caldera-Lurker takes Water damage, its pitch-black obsidian shadow-glass cracks violently under the sudden temperature shift. It emits a loud, hissing shriek of steam, permanently destroying its Obsidian Camouflage trait for the remainder of the encounter, and it takes an additional 5 (1d10) thunder damage from the sheer stress of the shattering glass.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Caldera-Lurker makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Molten Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Obsidian Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Eastersea Dossier: Geography, History, and Bestiary. They stalk the high-mana ocean trenches on the eastern edge of the world.

additionalAbilities.name: Shadow Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The Void-Orca has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Orca's allies is within 5ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: Current Manipulation
additionalAbilities.description: The Void-Orca uses shadow magic to subtly alter the water around it. As a bonus action, it can force one creature within 30ft. to make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15ft. in any direction of the Orca's choosing, silently separating vulnerable targets from their group.

actions.name: Crushing Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Abyssal Breach (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. The Orca dives down and breaches upward underneath a boat or swimming target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a vessel, it must make a DC 16 Strength saving throw or tip precariously, forcing all occupants to succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or fall into the water.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Eastersea Dossier: Geography, History, and Bestiary. They are anchored to deep-sea reefs and the sheer drop-offs of the eastern boundary.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from non-magical attacks

additionalAbilities.name: Shell Shield
additionalAbilities.description: While its shell is closed, the Void-Clam has resistance to all damage except radiant, and its AC is 19. It opens its shell to attack, dropping its AC to 12 until the start of its next turn.

additionalAbilities.name: Gravitic Draw
additionalAbilities.description: At the start of each of the Void-Clam's turns, every creature within 30ft. of it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pulled 10ft. toward the clam.

actions.name: Snap Shut
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is swallowed and trapped inside the shell. While swallowed, the target is blinded, restrained, and takes 14 (4d6) acid damage plus 10 (3d6) force damage at the start of each of the clam's turns. The clam can only have one creature swallowed at a time. To escape, the trapped creature or an ally outside must deal at least 25 damage to the open shell in a single turn, forcing the clam to regurgitate the victim.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Westerseam: Industrial Governance of the Worldsplit. They plague the upper gantries, cranes, and trash chutes of the Darvitch rigs.

additionalAbilities.name: Pack Tactics
additionalAbilities.description: The Scrapgull has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the Scrapgull's allies is within 5ft. of the creature and isn’t incapacitated.

additionalAbilities.name: Dive Attack
additionalAbilities.description: If the Scrapgull is flying and dives at least 30ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a Beak attack, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Jagged Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Wing-Shred
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

flavor.environment: They stalk the bubbling magma pools and volcanic channels surrounding the smolder-cores of Dimspark and the deep tunnels of Elz'Bereth.

additionalAbilities.name: Thermal Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Salachleon has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide near magma, fire, or extreme heat sources.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Salachleon makes two attacks: one with its Magma Tongue and one with its Bite.

actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Magma Tongue
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 20ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14) and pulled up to 15ft. straight toward the Salachleon.

flavor.environment: They hide within the unmined, jagged cavern walls and deep geological rifts of Elz'Bereth.

damageResistances: Piercing and Slashing from non-magical weapons

additionalAbilities.name: Jagged Reflection
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that hits the Dark Geode with a melee attack while within 5ft. of it takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage from the sharp crystalline protrusions.

additionalAbilities.name: Thermal Shock
additionalAbilities.description: Whenever the Dark Geode takes Water damage, its hot obsidian armor violently cracks, reducing its AC by -2 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Crystal Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Amorphous
additionalAbilities.description: The Current-Drifter can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

additionalAbilities.name: Water Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Current-Drifter has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

additionalAbilities.name: Shocking Aura
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that touches the Current-Drifter or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Constricting Shock
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10+2) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Lightning Pulse (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Current-Drifter emits a pulse of electrical energy. Each creature within 15 feet of it in the water must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Dracoseam: Chronicles of the Eastern Planar Boundary. They navigate the gravity-inverted air currents and cosmic waterfalls where the ocean plunges into the void.

additionalAbilities.name: Amphibious
additionalAbilities.description: The Brackish-Gale can breathe both air and water flawlessly.

additionalAbilities.name: Ink Jet Dash
additionalAbilities.description: While airborne or underwater, the Brackish-Gale can expel a massive jet of dark, brackish shadow-ink behind it, propelling itself forward. It may use this ability to take the Dash action as a bonus action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Brackish-Gale makes three tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Void Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Obscuring Ink Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The creature ejects a 60ft. cone of thick, blinding shadow-ink. The area becomes heavily obscured for 1minute or until dispersed by a strong wind or water current. Creatures caught in the spray must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Dracoseam: Chronicles of the Eastern Planar Boundary. They hover as mechanical and magical sentinels near critical planar leaks.

additionalAbilities.name: All-Seeing Eye
additionalAbilities.description: The Augur-Eye cannot be surprised and has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

additionalAbilities.name: Planar Distortion Ring
additionalAbilities.description: Ranged attacks made against the Augur-Eye have a -2 penalty to hit as its rotating glass rings distort space around its central eye.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Augur-Eye makes two attacks: one with its Obsidian Ring Strike and one with its Eye Beam.

actions.name: Obsidian Ring Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Eye Beam (Choose one at random)
actions.description: 1. Disintegration Beam: The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated into ash. 2. Gravity Squeeze Beam: The target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and is restrained by crushing gravitic force for 1minute (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Rift Teleport (Recharge 4-5)
actions.description: The Augur-Eye teleports, along with any equipment it is carrying, up to 60ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

flavor.environment: Derived from The Westerseam: Industrial Governance of the Worldsplit. They guard the rusting stairwells and abandoned generator levels of decommissioned platforms.

languages: Understands Common and Darvitch-Code but cannot speak

additionalAbilities.name: Darkling Synergy
additionalAbilities.description: While within 10ft. of another Darkling or Darkforged entity, the Rigman gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

additionalAbilities.name: Magnetic Grip
additionalAbilities.description: The Rigman has advantage on Athletics checks made to climb metal surfaces or grapple targets wearing heavy metal armor.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Rigman makes two attacks: one with its Heavy Wrench and one with its Arc-Welder.

actions.name: Heavy Wrench
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Arc-Welder
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

flavor.environment: It slumbers within the absolute deepest magma reservoirs, specifically the Old Belly Magma Chamber of Gildermount.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from non-magical weapons

additionalAbilities.name: Aura of the Smolder-Core
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 15ft. of the Blaze Drake takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Blaze Drake makes three attacks: one with its Bite and two with its Claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Void-Flame Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The drake exhales a 60ft. cone of black, necrotic fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

additionalAbilities.name: Flyby
additionalAbilities.description: The Gale-Screecher doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

additionalAbilities.name: Silent Drop
additionalAbilities.description: If the Gale-Screecher begins its turn clinging to the underside of a surface (like a rock bridge) and drops down onto a target, its first attack has advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Gale-Screecher makes two attacks with its Shadow-Glass Talons.

actions.name: Shadow-Glass Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Screech of the Abyss (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The creature releases a horrifying, whining shriek of pure void-resonance. Each creature within a 30-foot radius that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage, drops whatever it is holding, and is frightened until the end of its next turn. Furthermore, the sheer, pants-crapping terror of the screech forces the target to immediately make a DC 13 Potty Check; on a failure, they suffer a humiliating accident, losing 2 Use Charges if padded.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from non-magical weapons

additionalAbilities.name: Absolute-Zero Core
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature that hits the Frost-Gargantua with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Ablative Ice Armor
additionalAbilities.description: If the Frost-Gargantua takes Fire damage, its AC is reduced by 2 until the end of its next turn, as the thick, frosted ice-plates temporarily melt away to reveal the softer, bubbling shadow-tar beneath.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Frost-Gargantua makes two Ice-Spike Slam attacks.

actions.name: Ice-Spike Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 17).

actions.name: Absolute-Zero Bellow (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Frost-Gargantua exhales a terrifying 40-foot cone of pale-blue freezing mist and shadow-spores. Each creature in that area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) cold damage and its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn as it is encased in frost. The sheer, violent shock of the freezing mist against the victim's abdominal muscles forces an immediate DC 16 Continence Check. On a failure, the victim suffers a critical failure (instantly saturating their diaper to 0 charges and suffering the Heavy and Sodden penalties of the Wet condition). On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and suffers no additional effects.

damageResistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from non-magical weapons

additionalAbilities.name: Snow Camouflage
additionalAbilities.description: The Sleekrime-Stalker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy or icy terrain.

additionalAbilities.name: Frictionless Stride
additionalAbilities.description: The Stalker ignores difficult terrain composed of ice or snow, and its movement does not trigger tremorsense.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Stalker makes two attacks: one with its Shadow-Claws and one with its Thermal Bite.

actions.name: Shadow-Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Thermal Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have its core temperature violently drained, gaining 1 level of Exhaustion.

actions.name: Sonic Ice-Shatter (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The Stalker unleashes a localized, micro-sonic roar mimicking the Glimmergale. Each creature within a 30-foot cone must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Any ice or snow beneath the targets instantly shatters, rendering the area difficult terrain and forcing a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling prone into shallow, jagged crevasses.

stats.speed: 30 ft., swim 40 ft., climb 30 ft. (ice only)

additionalAbilities.name: Ice Walk
additionalAbilities.description: The Blackdeep Shark can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

additionalAbilities.name: Unsettling Presence (The Ice-Terror)
additionalAbilities.description: Any creature within 25 ft. that witnesses the Blackdeep Shark's sudden transition from aquatic to terrestrial posture, accompanied by the screech of its obsidian crab-legs digging into the ice, must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or suffer a brown note incident, instantly losing their reactions until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Blackdeep Shark makes two attacks: one with its Ravenous Bite and one with its Obsidian Crab-Claws.

actions.name: Ravenous Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Obsidian Crab-Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
